title: Things couples do but never admit

slides.title: The hoodie *“borrowing.”*
slides.body: It’s been eight months. It lives in your closet now.

slides.title: Smelling *their pillow.*
slides.body: Only when they’re away. Only a little. Okay, a lot.

slides.title: Winning arguments *in the shower.*
slides.body: You had the perfect comeback. Three days too late.

slides.title: Checking *they’re breathing.*
slides.body: They sleep too still. You had to make sure.

slides.title: “I don’t mind” *(you mind).*
slides.body: You minded. You still mind. You will always mind.

slides.title: Save this *and confess in the comments.*
slides.sub: Which case file are you guilty of?
